invariants.rationale: The method immediately calls element.getName() and element.getAttribute(), which require element to be non-null.
The method uses tideFile in getRelativeFileHandle and to resolve paths, so it must be non-null.
The method calls imageResolver.getImage(), so imageResolver must not be null.
The method accesses map.getTileSets(), so map must be non-null.
The method uses element.getName().equals("TileSheet"), so getName() must not return null.
